subtitle: Lesson 39 · Monitoring & Error Handling

caption: Monitor → Alerts & metrics is the entry point for every alert in this data factory.
Failed activity, pipeline, and trigger runs, plus IR health metrics — each individually selectable.
Filter by ActivityType, ActivityName, or PipelineName — one tightly-scoped alert per critical pipeline.
Default is zero retries — you opt in. A flaky source system often just needs one more try.

subtitle: Designing pipelines that fail gracefully, not just pipelines that fail.
